# Kawaii Group (Japan-Bangladesh Joint Venture)

> Kawaii Group Bangladesh is a premier Japan-Bangladesh joint venture conglomerate founded in 1987. With over 35+ years of excellence, the group bridges cultures, fosters international partnerships, and empowers businesses and careers across Bangladesh, Japan, Canada, Germany, and Malaysia.

## Core Pillars & Services
- **Human Resources & Global Recruitment**: Connecting skilled Bangladeshi engineers, professionals, and trainees with leading companies and institutions in Japan under SSW (Specified Skilled Worker), TITP, and professional engineering categories.
- **Japanese Language & Career Training**: Intensive language education (JLPT N5 to N1), Japanese business etiquette, and technical orientation for global career placement.
- **BIM & Construction DX**: Spearheading Digital Transformation (DX) in architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) across Bangladesh through expert masterclasses and seminars led by Japanese industry veterans (e.g., Dr. Shunsuke Someya).
- **Business Consultancy & Joint Ventures**: Supporting Japanese enterprises investing in Bangladesh and helping Bangladeshi ventures access Japanese and global markets.
- **Global Trade, Fashion & Technology**: Diversified sister concerns in apparel sourcing, trading, software solutions, and cross-border innovation.

## Subsidiaries & Sister Concerns
- **Kawaii Japan Career & HR Solutions**: Japan-focused talent recruitment, training, and career transition programs.
- **Kawaii Global Ventures**: Investment, business development, and international market expansion.
- **Kawaii Fashion & Trade**: High-standard garment manufacturing, export, and international supply chain solutions.
- **Kawaii Language & Skill Academy**: Premier Japanese language learning institute in Dhaka.
